To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

work as a calling is a complex phenomenon that is best understood by examining how the antecedents of a calling (e.g., calling motivation, person–environment fit, and access to opportunity) interact and influence one another to shape the experience of a lived calling.

the work as calling theory provides an initial empirical test of a comprehensive theoretical framework for understanding how work can be a calling, with the results providing evidence for the importance of person–environment fit, calling motivation, and job crafting as key factors that can help to translate a perceived call into a lived calling.

work as calling theory is a promising framework to help understand the predictors of living out a work calling, and that person–environment fit, work meaning, career commitment, calling motivation, and job crafting appear to be critical to translating a calling into a lived calling.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question, how does one go about living out a calling?
the role that a sense of calling may have in helping individuals to live more meaningful and fulfilling lives, as well as the ways in which the work environment may influence this.
the role of work as a source of meaning in people’s lives.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the WCT is a promising theoretical model that provides an important framework for research on work as calling.

work as calling theory is an important and valuable theory that has been supported by the data collected for this study and that it is a valuable theory that should be used by researchers, career counselors and employers.
the WCT is a useful framework to guide the study of work as a lived calling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the WCT is a useful framework to help understand the predictors and outcomes associated with living out a calling at work.
the Work as Calling theory provides a useful framework for understanding the antecedents and consequences of work as a meaningful calling.
the WCT provides a promising framework for understanding work as a calling and its implications for employees, organizations, and society. (PsycINFO Database Record (c) 2019 APA, all rights reserved)
The main takeaway from our work is that
a calling is more than a feeling; it is a way of living that is shaped by a variety of factors.
the WCT provides a useful theoretical framework for understanding and promoting calling in organizations.

the WCT is an important theoretical model for understanding the antecedents and consequences of work as a lived calling, and we recommend that future research continue to examine the model propositions in a variety of occupational contexts and cultures.
